name: bounded-revenue-proof-loop
objective: Prove one useful revenue workflow without creating a second command center or upgrading missing evidence.

pattern.output: one exact outcome, client route, evidence window, and authority boundary
source-located current evidence or an explicit pending field
pass, revise, or blocked with reproduced checks
redacted receipt, approval state, evidence paths, risks, and one next-safe action

fail_closed_when: source evidence is unavailable or stale
client, account, repository, or authority is ambiguous
delivery would require an unapproved external action
